author: Inside Edition
description: Police rushed to a report of an armed suspect waiting outside a house. A frantic homeowner called 911 thinking an assassin was lying in wait. After police closed in, they found that it was actually a kid with a water gun taking part in a nationwide craze called "senior assassin" that is causing chaos across the country this graduation season. The student was briefly detained and released when cops realized it was a prank. Authorities are issuing a warning that senior assassins can be dangerous.
title: Teen Playing 'Senior Assassin' Detained After Homeowner Calls 911

author: Inside Edition
description: A group of nursing students rushed into a hospital room for an intense simulation of what they would face in a real emergency. The students are entering what many are calling America's hottest profession. There is growing concern that AI will replace humans in lots of white collar jobs but it seems unlikely with manual or skilled labor jobs like plumbers, mechanics or construction workers and professions like nursing. Columbia University School of Nursing student Ryan Haas spoke with Inside Edition.
title: Why Is Nursing Becoming One Of The Hottest Professions?

author: Inside Edition
description: Do you know how to spot the juiciest limes? How about the sweetest oranges? And can you tell the difference between an organic and a non-organic apple? INSIDE EDITION’s Ann Mercogliano teamed up with professional chef and Food Network’s Chopped Champion Lauren Covas to learn the “Secrets of Fruit” you need to know if you want to get the most out of your next trip to the grocery store.
title: How To Pick The Freshest Produce At The Grocery Store

author: Inside Edition
description: It's a new, yet old-fashioned, way to pass time at the airport. A machine that dispenses short stories on demand for children and adults, even those who want to read in Spanish. The Short Story Dispensary is a creation of a French publishing house, Short Edition. They have 600 installed across the world and about 300 in the United States. This one can be found in Terminal two at the Ontario International Airport in California. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Short Story Dispensary Prints Reading Material On Demand
